features.featureTitle: Wire the frontend React Query hooks to the real backend profile methods: update `useGetCallerUserProfile` and `useSaveCallerUserProfile` in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` to call the backend methods, keep the existing query key `['currentUserProfile']`, and ensure the query is invalidated/refetched on successful save so the Profile Setup dialog is dismissed by `App.tsx` logic.
